curriculumHighlights.text: Branch change happens once, at the end of the first semester, on first-semester performance alone. A branch may lose or gain at most 10% of its strength, at least one student per discipline is always considered, and Engineering Design dual-degree students are excluded.

sources.title: Ordinances and Regulations: B.Tech / B.Tech (Honours), IIT Madras (R.5.0 Change of Branch, clauses R.5.2-R.5.5)

curriculumHighlights.text: B.Tech (Honours) is opted into during the fourth semester by students with CGPA 8.5 or above after the third semester and every course cleared at first attempt; it needs at least 12 extra professional-major credits plus a compulsory project.

sources.title: Ordinances and Regulations: B.Tech / B.Tech (Honours), IIT Madras (R.1.12 and R.2.8)

curriculumHighlights.text: Minor streams start in the fifth semester: a package of at least three courses coordinated by one department (others may participate), so a student can add a second discipline alongside the professional major.

sources.title: Ordinances and Regulations: B.Tech / B.Tech (Honours), IIT Madras (R.2.2 Minor Stream)

curriculumHighlights.text: A 4-year B.Tech can convert to the 5-year B.Tech + M.Tech dual degree within the same department during the sixth semester, provided CGPA is at least 8.0 after the fifth semester and there are no backlogs; dual-degree students cannot move back to the 4-year track.

sources.title: Ordinances and Regulations: B.Tech / B.Tech (Honours), IIT Madras (R.5.7 and R.5.8)
Ordinances and Regulations: Dual Degree (B.Tech and M.Tech), applicable from the 2015 batch

curriculumHighlights.text: Interdisciplinary Dual Degrees (IDDD) let a B.Tech student of any branch with CGPA 8.0 or more after the fifth semester add an M.Tech from the sixth semester in areas such as Quantum Science and Technology, Advanced Materials, Complex Systems or Quantitative Finance; 12 IDDDs existed by December 2022.

sources.title: Interdisciplinary Dual Degree Program - Department of Physics, IIT Madras (minimum 8 CGPA at end of 5th semester)
IIT Madras launches new Interdisciplinary Dual Degree on Quantitative Finance (12 IDDDs as of December 2022; entry from sixth semester)

curriculumHighlights.text: Semester exchange through the Office of Global Engagement: apply after three to four semesters with no backlogs and preferably a CGPA of 7.5 or more, spend five to six months at a partner university, and budget roughly Rs 4-6 lakh depending on the country.

sources.title: Semester Exchange - Office of Global Engagement, IIT Madras

curriculumHighlights.text: Credit-based curriculum with elective baskets: B.Tech and dual-degree students may earn up to 36 credits through NPTEL or approved online courses (never for core courses), and from the fifth semester a CGPA-linked cap limits how many credits can be registered per semester.

sources.title: Curriculum FAQs 2026 - Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Madras (NPTEL credits; CGPA-based credit limit)

curriculumHighlights.text: The 5-year Engineering Design dual degree includes a semester-long industry internship on a live project, with specialisations in Automotive Engineering, Biomedical Design, Robotics and Electric Vehicles.

sources.title: Dual Degree Programme | Department of Engineering Design, IIT Madras

research.note: Research dominates the campus profile: the institute counts 2,963 PhD and 746 MS research scholars against about 2,100 undergraduates. The NIRF 2025 return lists 1,798 full-time and 200 part-time doctoral students on roll to 2023-24, 314 PhDs awarded that year, and 794 sponsored projects worth about Rs 956 crore in 2023-24. The IITM Research Park and incubation cell sit next to campus.
